FVTTATLAS.Settings.ShowStartupNotice.Hin: When enabled, show the GM a notification after the world loads. This is a diagnostic only.
FVTTATLAS.Notifications.Ready: FVTT Atlas Navigation: Module loaded successfully.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.NoScene: No Scene is currently viewed. Open a Scene on the canvas and try again.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.Enabled: Use this Scene as an atlas
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.EnabledHint: Turning this off hides atlas functionality but preserves its stored network for later.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.OneEditor: Development limitation: only one GM should edit an atlas at a time. Changes by another GM while this dialog is open will be rejected when detected.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.Saved: Atlas settings saved for this Scene.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.SceneSettingsHint: Per-Scene Atlas status and native Grid measurement. Roads, Waypoints, and Region lists will be added here in the next Phase 2 slices.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.Inactive: Atlas not yet enabled for this Scene.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.GridUnavailable: This Scene has no usable Grid distance or pixel size. Configure them in the native Grid tab; Atlas has no separate distance override.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.SceneGridSaveHint: Atlas always uses native Scene Grid measurement. Save any Grid tab changes first. Future road distances will be measured with Foundry's own grid path measurement, including hex and gridless rules.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.NativeOnly: To change distances or units, edit this Scene's native Grid tab. Atlas does not have a manual scale override.
